entra-domain-services-single-replica-pro.title: Production domain has a single replica set
entra-domain-services-single-replica-pro.body: This production managed domain has one replica set, so it lives in one Azure region. Microsoft says additional replica sets in other regions give geographic disaster recovery if a region goes offline. Each extra replica set is billed at the same hourly rate; priced as requested. Ask the customer whether regional disaster recovery is needed before adding one.

citation.source: Replica sets concepts and features for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
citation.quote: Additional replica sets in different Azure regions provide geographical disaster recovery for legacy applications if an Azure region goes offline.

entra-domain-services-standard-backup-pr.title: Production domain on the Standard SKU has the least frequent backups
entra-domain-services-standard-backup-pr.body: This production managed domain uses the Standard SKU, which Microsoft lists with a backup every five days; Enterprise backs up every three days and Premium daily. Microsoft says to review your recovery point objective (RPO) to pick the backup frequency. Priced as requested; ask the customer how much directory change they can afford to lose before keeping Standard.

citation.source: Management concepts for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
citation.quote: Review your business requirements and recovery point objective (RPO) to determine the required backup frequency for your managed domain.
